Coloidal Silver

Supplement colloidal-silver antimicrobial infection immune-support

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Colloidal silver has antimicrobial properties against a wide range of pathogens; used for infections and immune support.

Indications

  • infections
  • immune support
  • skin conditions
  • respiratory issues

Contraindications

  • long-term use (argyria risk)
  • conflicts with antibiotics
  • thyroid disorders

Preparations

  • liquid
  • gel
  • capsules

Body Systems Affected

  • immune
  • integumentary
  • respiratory

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Asthma
    Chronic inflammatory disease of the airways that causes wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
  • Acid Reflux / GERD
    Gastroesophageal reflux disease causing heartburn and acid regurgitation.
